rules.method: Sun above/below horizon; Sun/Jupiter/Saturn diurnal, Moon/Venus/Mars nocturnal. Mercury uses morning/evening phase.
rules.author: Chris Brennan and guests
exceptions: Geometric center horizon threshold is explicit implementation convention; refraction, terrain and a solar-disk convention can change borderline sect.

rules.method: Morning Mercury diurnal; evening Mercury nocturnal.
rules.author: Robert Hand / Chris Brennan
exceptions: Hand also discusses an application-based alternative; not implemented. Longitude phase is computed, not actual visibility.

rules.method: Domicile, exaltation, triplicity, bounds and ten-degree faces are table lookups; debilities are detriment/fall.
rules.author: William Lilly; Skyscript presentation
rules.locator: Main dignity diagram and separate Egyptian terms diagram
exceptions: Egyptian and Lilly-Ptolemaic bounds remain distinct. Lilly's table is not identical to all Ptolemy transmissions. Exaltation degree is reported as data; dignity applies throughout its sign.

rules.method: Day/night priority rulers plus participating ruler; Lilly uses two rulers, with Mars ruling water in both sects.
rules.author: Deborah Houlding
rules.locator: Ancient Assignment of Triplicity Rulers; nocturnal Scorpio example
examples: Nocturnal Scorpio: Mars, Venus, Moon in priority order.
exceptions: Participating rulership is exposed separately; no universal dignity score.

rules.method: The dignity owner receives the visiting planet; mutual reception is reciprocal. Optional aspect-required rule uses sign configuration and major dignity or two minor dignities.
rules.author: Deborah Houlding
examples: Sun at 25 Libra at night: Venus domicile, Saturn exaltation, Mercury triplicity, Mars term, Jupiter face in Lilly tables.
exceptions: Occupancy, sign-level aspect-required reception and Hellenistic domicile dispositorship are separate policies. No claim to full Bonatti perfection rules.

rules.method: CA p.113: same-sign combustion below 8.5 degrees; beams below 17; cazimi within 17 arcminutes. Earlier beams convention: 15 degrees, without medieval combustion/cazimi categories.
rules.author: Skyscript glossary citing William Lilly
examples: Lilly: Sun 15°30 Taurus and Venus 15°25 Taurus is cazimi.
exceptions: Lilly p.300 instead uses 12-degree beams and 16-minute cazimi; this conflicting passage is recorded but not merged into CA113. No naked-eye visibility guarantee.

rules.method: Day Fortune ASC+Moon−Sun, Spirit ASC+Sun−Moon; reverse each at night.
rules.author: NCGR Geocosmic Journal contributors
rules.locator: The Hellenistic Lots: Fortune & Spirit, displayed formulas
exceptions: Fixed-day Fortune is a separate convention; Spirit remains sect-reversing. Lots are symbolic points, not physical bodies.

rules.method: Fortune uses ASC+Moon−Sun for day and night.
rules.author: William Lilly
rules.locator: p.143, Of the Part of Fortune, and how to take it, either by Day or Night
exceptions: Spirit is not attributed to Lilly here; its formula remains separately sourced.
